issue.title: test_prompt_insert_ctrl_j_prefix_is_its_own_undo_checkpoint splits one insert into multiple undo checkpoints under the full parallel lane
issue.description:
`test_prompt_insert_ctrl_j_prefix_is_its_own_undo_checkpoint` asserts that a `ctrl+j`
bullet insert plus the characters typed after it form a single undo checkpoint, so one
`u` returns the buffer to `"- item\n- "`. Under the full parallel test lane the undo
instead stepped back a single character, leaving `"- item\n- ne"`.

Discovered while landing epic sase-pw. Passes reliably in isolation and serially; only
the parallel lane has reproduced it, once.

task_type_fields.evidence:
**Fail:** 1 failure in the escalated full parallel lane (`just test-scoped`, which escalated
on `core-identity-changed`): 33728 passed, 13 skipped, 1 failed in 332.91s. The failure landed
on xdist worker `gw3`, at master HEAD `00e396be8` plus a 2-line import fix in
`src/sase/main/project_handler.py` (unrelated file, CLI handler only).

**Assertion:**

```
async with PromptPage("- item", cursor=(0, 6), mode="insert") as page:
    await page.press("ctrl+j", "n", "e", "w", "escape")
    assert page.text == "- item\n- new"      # passed
    await page.press("u")
>   assert page.text == "- item\n- "
E   AssertionError: assert '- item\n- ne' == '- item\n- '
```

So `u` undid only the final `w` instead of the whole `n`/`e`/`w` insert: the three
keystrokes did not coalesce into one undo checkpoint.

**Pass:** 4 consecutive isolated passes of the node on the same tree, plus the whole
43-test file serially (`-p no:randomly`, 43 passed in 7.68s). Fail rate observed: 1/5
under the parallel lane, 0/5 serially — it reproduces only under parallel contention.

**Hypothesis (unverified):** TextArea undo entries coalesce on a wall-clock threshold, so
under CPU contention the simulated `n`/`e`/`w` presses can straddle that window and split
one insert into multiple undo entries. If that is the cause, the fix belongs in the test
(drive the checkpoint deterministically) rather than in the widget.

**Not caused by the reporter.** Filed by the land agent for epic `sase-pw`
(current project from the VCS xprompt MRU). That epic touches
`sase.current_project`, `sase.ace.tui.project_styles`, the top-bar indicator, project
filter seeds, and `sase project current` — nothing in the prompt bar, vim mode, or undo.
The nearest recent change to the vim-editor area is `c6bee0051`
("use vim editors for every typed freeform field", bead sase-q3.1), but it only touched
`input_collection_modal.py`, `secret_vim_text_area.py`, and `typed_input_form.py` — not
`vim_text_area.py` and not the prompt input — so the link is topical, not causal.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: just test-scoped  # escalated to the full parallel lane
